recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-34840 follow-up is needed in core unless a separate ticket decides to adjust related display text or neighboring marketDistribution wording.
issue_request: FHIR-34840 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO. It reported that DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution incorrectly reused the issuer definition "The organization that assigns the identifier algorithm" and requested the definition be corrected to "Indicates where and when the device is available on the market".
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies commit 2a3c31605e1f057f27252ba2e95f5846008f13bd as the application. Git show confirms that commit replaced the copied issuer definition with the requested market availability definition, and blame still attributes the current definition line to that commit.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml current build-scope source. Same-family published issues FHIR-32976 and FHIR-33950 introduced and refined marketDistribution but do not conflict with FHIR-34840. OO Confluence minutes for 2022-01-07 confirm the FHIR-34840 vote, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because line 685 of source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml already says "Indicates where and when the device is available on the market." The remaining "identifier algorithm" wording is on the neighboring issuer element, where it belongs.

related_jiras.note: Introduced marketDistribution as part of the DeviceDefinition market status model before FHIR-34840 corrected the copied definition.
Mandated marketPeriod and subJurisdiction under marketDistribution without changing or conflicting with the FHIR-34840 definition correction.
